name: @fireback/auth-client
description: Standalone client for a fireback project's self-service authentication: session/workspace state (backed by localStorage), the AuthenticationProvider/useAuthentication React context, and helpers to redirect to self-service login and capture the session it hands back. No fireback-specific dependencies beyond React itself, so any React project can depend on just this package to talk to a fireback backend's auth - it doesn't require ui-core, manage, or any other fireback UI package.
